effect @e[type=fox,scores={fmbe_display=1}] invisibility 999999 1 true
effect @e[type=fox,scores={fmbe_display=1}] resistance 999999 255 true
scoreboard players set @e[scores={fmbe_group=1..}] fmbe_anim 1

execute positioned ~-1.5~~-0.5 run playanimation @e[x=~,z=~,y=~,dx=1,dy=0,dz=0] animation.player.attack.positions _ 0 "v.xpos=0; v.ypos=0; v.zpos=0; v.xrot=0; v.yrot=0; v.zrot=0; v.scale=1; v.extend_scale=1; v.extend_xrot=0; v.extend_yrot=0; v.xbasepos=0; v.ybasepos=0; v.zbasepos=0;" base

execute positioned ~-1.5~~-0.5 run playanimation @e[x=~,z=~,y=~,dx=1,dy=0,dz=0] animation.player.attack.positions _ 0 "v.xpos=0; v.ypos=0; v.zpos=0; v.xrot=15; v.yrot=0; v.zrot=0; v.scale=0.5; v.extend_scale=1; v.extend_xrot=0; v.extend_yrot=0; v.xbasepos=0; v.ybasepos=0; v.zbasepos=0;" head
